title: Kissed Flaky Norwegian Oats Bake
description: A malty, flaky, one-pot Norwegian dish featuring coco sugar and lacquer glaze, suitable for Jain-friendly diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the rolled oats, coco sugar, and malted milk powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the lacquer glaze, coconut oil, vanilla extract, and salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Add the water to the mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Transfer the dough to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the kissed flaky Norwegian oats bake warm, garnished with additional coco sugar if desired.
